statBlock.name: Hybrid Brute
statBlock.description: A Guardian Project volunteer with thick natural armor and claws suited to close combat on land or underwater.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The hybrid breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Hybrid Flier
statBlock.description: A Simic guardian who fights from the air with javelins and jets of acid.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Javelin attacks. You can replace one with Spit Acid.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Spit Acid. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (4d4) acid damage.

statBlock.name: Hybrid Poisoner
statBlock.description: A Simic guardian whose poison punishes attackers who close to melee range.

sections.Traits:
Assassinate. On the hybrid’s first turn, it has advantage on attacks against creatures that have yet to take a turn. A hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Poisonous Skin. A creature takes 3 (1d6) poison damage if it touches the hybrid or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
sections.Actions: Toxic Touch. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. The target must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns while poisoned this way, it must repeat the save. On a failure it takes 3 (1d6) poison damage. On a success the poison ends.

statBlock.name: Hybrid Shocker
statBlock.description: An electrically charged Simic guardian that pulls enemies into reach with its tentacles.

sections.Traits:
Electrified Body. A creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage if it touches the hybrid or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
Illumination. The hybrid gives off bright light within 10 ft. and dim light for another 10 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Shocking Touch attack and one Tentacles attack.
Shocking Touch. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit grapples the creature (escape DC 11) and pulls it up to 15 ft. straight toward the hybrid. The creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage at the start of each of its turns while this grapple lasts. Until the grapple ends, the hybrid cannot use Tentacles on another creature.

statBlock.name: Hybrid Spy
statBlock.description: A Simic scout who can blend into a wall and cross a ceiling.

sections.Traits:
Chameleon Skin. The hybrid has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Spider Climb. The hybrid can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Indentured Spirit
statBlock.description: An Orzhov debtor bound to serve after death, with chains draped across its ghostly robes.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, fire, lightning, and thunder. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, and restrained.
sections.Languages: The languages it knew while alive.
sections.Traits: Incorporeal Movement. Treat other creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. The spirit takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
sections.Actions: Withering Touch. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Debts Paid: If a Deathpact Angel has granted the spirit this clause, the spirit can destroy itself when it sees that angel drop to 0 HP. This clears the debt and restores the angel to life with 1 HP. This optional pact appears on p. 191.
